draft.subject: Your weekly summary question — and next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks for writing in about the weekly summary email — your ticket is still open with our support team, and to be straight with you: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, so no screenshotting workaround is something I'd love to spare you.

In the meantime, you've got your first project up, which is the main organizing unit in Wrenfield — tasks live inside them. Getting real tasks in there is where the first week starts paying off.

Want me to walk through that with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Chidi
